Address and other details submitted through membership or registration forms.

Subject to applicable laws, you may request access to, correction of or deletion of your personal information held by us. You may also contact us regarding concerns about how your information is being used.

Our website is not intended to knowingly collect personal information from children without appropriate consent. If you believe that a child has submitted personal information through our website, please contact us.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our website practices or applicable requirements. Any updates will be published on this page with the revised date.
If you have questions, concerns or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or the handling of your personal information, please contact Sarvjan Sanatan Party through our website.
